name: The Wine — Change What's in the Glass

segments.vo_text: That glass of wine? It isn't calming you down. I know — I didn't want to hear it either. But stay with me, because this explains a lot.
segments.notes: Cold open, no music sting — dry room tone to sell the 'stay with me' honesty. Hold her eye contact.

segments.vo_text: Here's what's actually happening. Wine quiets your brain for about two hours. Then, while you sleep, it bounces back the other way — harder.
segments.notes: B-roll over VO. The cooling light foreshadows the 'bounce back.' Cut on 'harder.'

segments.vo_text: That's why you're wide awake at 3am, heart pounding about nothing. The nightly glass that takes the edge off is the thing sharpening it.
segments.notes: The emotional low point. Match-cut hand-on-chest to imply heartbeat. Keep it sympathetic, not scary.

segments.vo_text: And I'm not going to tell you to just quit and white-knuckle your evenings. I tried that. It didn't work.
segments.notes: Tone shift to relief/permission. The pushed-away empty glass sets up the swap.

segments.vo_text: What worked was keeping my ritual — and changing what's in it. Another mom put me onto these microdose gummies.
segments.notes: Hero product reveal — flame gummy + swapped glass. Pouch must be unbranded/blank. This is the pivot shot.

segments.vo_text: One gummy in the evening instead of the pour. The calm shows up — but it doesn't bounce back on you. And there's a lab report in every pouch, so I knew exactly what I was taking.
segments.notes: Lab-sheet = the trust beat. Keep the document generic (rows of values, no readable brand). Steady, unhurried.

segments.vo_text: That first week, I slept through the night for the first time in months. By week three, the edge just… wasn't there to take off anymore.
segments.notes: The 'Glow' rendered as behavior — laughter, ease, presence, NOT a medical claim. Warm-vs-cool contrast with shot 3 does the storytelling.

segments.vo_text: So keep the ritual. The couch. The exhale. The end of the day, marked. Just change what's in the glass. 60-day guarantee — full refund, no hoops. Link below.
segments.notes: Bookend the ritual. End on her settled expression for the CTA. Pouch/sheet visible but blank for lower-third graphics in edit.
